abstract: We examined peripheral blood T-lymphocyte subsets before initiation of therapy in 79 healthy controls, 3 patients with endometriosis, 95 patients with common epithelial tumors of the ovary, 15 patients with ovarian germ cell tumors, and 3 patients with ovarian sex cord-stromal tumors. In stage Ia/Ib patients with epithelial ovarian cancer, the percentages of activated CD4+ (CD4+HLA-DR+) T cells and activated CD4+ T cells in the CD4+ T-cell subsets were significantly higher than those of healthy controls and patients with benign or borderline epithelial tumors of the ovary. These immunologic parameters were subsequently decreased in patients in stage Ic and more advanced stages. In malignant ovarian germ cell tumors, a similar increase in the CD4+ T-cell subsets was observed. Moreover, the percentage of activated CD8+ T cells in the CD8+ T-cell subsets in stage Ia/Ib patients increased significantly compared with those in healthy controls and patients with benign tumors. Our findings indicate that activated T lymphocytes may play some roles in oncogenesis and progression of both epithelial ovarian cancer and malignant ovarian germ cell tumors.
abstract_ja: 健常者、子宮内膜症の患者3例、上皮性卵巣癌95例、卵巣胚細胞腫瘍15例、卵巣性索間質腫瘍3例において、治療開始前の末梢血Tリンパ球サブセットを検討した。Ia/Ib期の上皮性卵巣癌患者では、CD4+HLA-DR+T細胞およびCD4+T細胞サブセット中の活性化CD4+T細胞の割合が、健常者や良性・境界悪性の上皮性卵巣腫瘍患者より有意に高かった。これらの免疫学的指標はIc期以降の進行期患者では低下した。悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍でも、CD4+T細胞サブセットの同様の増加がみられた。さらに、Ia/Ib期患者ではCD8+T細胞サブセット中の活性化CD8+T細胞の割合が、健常者や良性腫瘍患者より有意に増加していた。活性化Tリンパ球は、上皮性卵巣癌と悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の双方の発がんと進展に関与する可能性が示された。
